name: squat-dumbbell-biceps-curl
title: Squat: Dumbbell (Biceps Curl)
primer: This exercise combines a squat with a curl to effectively work the entire body.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand and curl your arms up to your shoulders.
Bending at the hips and knees, squat down as you lower your hands to the floor (the lower part of a curl).
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
tips: Contract your biceps as you curl your arms up.
